notes.title: Songs of Armageddopolis is our next game
notes.notes:
If you need an unusual detective game, we have some.
Songs of Armageddopolis is a point'n'click detective game where death is irreversible, intuition is more important than logic, and the main evidence is you.
The game will be on Steam at October 13.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1719680/Songs_of_Armageddopolis/

notes.title: Trading cards are available!
notes.notes:
Finally, it happened!
Trading cards for the Dark Grim Mariupolis.
If you ask me, what's taking so long, I'll answer you: all the cards were fip drawn by fugu-freelancers. As you know, ink is water soluble, and it takes a huge amount of time to finish this work.
So enjoy this unique art!
